main_body: A magenta vending machine with a grey-blue top hood, a pink front-edge line, and a front face holding an inset shelf window and a coin slot
top_band: Pale grey-blue band, rows 0-5, with a dark slot inset in it; a pink line at rows 6-7 marks the front edge
evidence: Reading down the middle column: a light grey top band of about 5 rows, then a bright pink front-edge line, then a darker magenta band under it as shadow, then a tall front face. The product window has a dark inner border and an inset shelf, so it reads as recessed. The top is short and foreshortened compared with the 30-row body. It is borderline, because the dark slot in the top could be read as a vertical header panel, but the lighter band, the edge line and the shadow row together hold up as 3/4.

style.evidence: The outline is a dark purple lean, which suits the material. The magenta body has only about 3-4 steps, and the lower panel (rows 24-30) and the side margins are large flat fills with no grain or speckle. The grey top has about 3 tones. The product window has some variety, but most tiles carry only 3-5 colours, so the piece is thinner and flatter than the roofed well and the cheese stall.
